message.content:
The Battle of Waterloo was one of the bloodiest engagements of the Napoleonic Wars.  In total, the combined casualties for both sides were roughly **48,000** men.  Breaking it down:

| Side | Approximate casualties (killed, wounded, missing) |
|------|---------------------------------------------------|
| Allied (British, Dutch, Belgian, Prussian) | ~23,000 |
| French | ~25,000 |

These figures are rounded estimates drawn from contemporary reports and modern scholarship.
